import numpy as np

def distillation_loss(student_logits, teacher_logits, labels, T=2.0, alpha=0.5):
    # Hard loss
    student_probs = np.exp(student_logits) / np.sum(np.exp(student_logits))
    hard_loss = -np.sum(labels * np.log(student_probs + 1e-10))
    # Soft loss
    soft_teacher = np.exp(teacher_logits / T) / np.sum(np.exp(teacher_logits / T))
    soft_student = np.exp(student_logits / T) / np.sum(np.exp(student_logits / T))
    soft_loss = np.sum(soft_teacher * np.log(soft_teacher / (soft_student + 1e-10) + 1e-10))
    # Combine
    total_loss = alpha * hard_loss + (1 - alpha) * T**2 * soft_loss
    return total_loss
